faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Gandhinagar Program Assistant I (Full-Time Coach) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the IIT Gandhinagar Program Assistant I (Full-Time Coach) recruitment is 06 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Program Assistant I (Full-Time Coach) post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies available for the Program Assistant I (Full-Time Coach) position at IIT Gandhinagar.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Bachelor of Physical Education (B.P.Ed. or equivalent) or a Bachelor's Degree with a Postgraduate Diploma/Diploma/Certificate in Sports Coaching from a recognized institution.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 50 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Program Assistant I (Full-Time Coach) position?
faq.answer: The salary offered ranges from Rs. 28,000 to Rs. 53,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Practical Test and an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for this job?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official IIT Gandhinagar website before the last date. Specific instructions are provided in the "How to Apply" section.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity at IIT Gandhinagar.
